question: For the carcinogenic molecules in the toxicology database, how many carbon-carbon bonds are there of each bond type (single, double, and triple)? Please give me the bond type and the corresponding count.
evidence: A molecule labelled '+' is carcinogenic. Bond types are recorded as follows: a single bond as '-', a double bond as '=', and a triple bond as '#'. A carbon-carbon bond is a bond whose two bonded atoms are both carbon.
gold_sql: SELECT b.bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count FROM connected c JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2 JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c' AND m.label = '+' GROUP BY b.bond_type ORDER BY b.bond_type;

expected.sql: SELECT b.bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count FROM connected c JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2 JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c' AND m.label = '+' GROUP BY b.bond_type ORDER BY b.bond_type;
